RESULT [labelnoise]: With real-world box noise (γ≈0.15), Faster R-CNN mAP rose from 57.1% to 83.1% (+26.0), and with synthetic noise at γ=0.15 from 58.5% to 82.1%. With 1% of labels the method reached about 75% of fully supervised performance.
US [labelnoise]: This is agricultural evidence that box-localization noise is large and fixable. It supports iterative box refinement for OWLv2 or harvested boxes before they enter the base dataset.
CORRECTION [labelnoise]: Confirmed: Frontiers in Plant Science 14:1238722 (2023). Results are 57.1→83.1 under real noise γ≈0.15, 58.5→82.1 under synthetic noise γ=0.15, and about 75% of fully supervised performance with 1% of labels.
